title: Mont Blanc massif destablilized by summer heatwaves and rockfalls
subhed: As a result of extreme temperatures, which have weakened both its ice and its rock faces, the highest peak in the Alps is currently inaccessible by any of its three standard climbing routes.

title: Kyiv's brief glimmers of joy amidst war: 'Never in my life have I seen so many beautiful people in one place'
